class.name: InventoryItemDefinition
class.brief_description: What an item is: its name, its stack size and its fragments.
class.description: Shared by every [InventoryItemInstance] of the item and never written at runtime. To reach clients a definition has to be a saved resource ([code].tres[/code]): replication sends its path and the client loads the same file. [codeblock] var icon := item.get_item_definition().find_fragment_by_class(&"InventoryFragmentQuickBarIcon") [/codeblock]

method.name: find_fragment_by_class
method.description: Returns the first fragment of the given type, or [code]null[/code]. [param fragment_class] may be a native class name ([code]&"InventoryFragmentPickup"[/code]), a script's [code]class_name[/code], or the script itself ([code]preload("my_fragment.gd")[/code]). Subclasses match.

members.member: What the item is made of - see [InventoryItemFragment].
How many units fit in one inventory entry. [code]1[/code] means every unit is its own instance.
